office_does: A District Court judge hears civil, small claims, criminal and traffic cases.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Paul Wohl, a District Court commissioner with no prior elected experience, is the only candidate on the ballot, so the seat will have a new judge.

candidates.summary: District Court commissioner for 12 years and former Olympia city prosecutor, running unopposed for an open judgeship.
highlights: Prosecutor and public defender before that, including 14 years as Olympia's prosecutor [S1]
Washington State Judicial College instructor and Associate Dean [S1]
